answer: Each challenge binds its parameters to a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse, whose unpredictable, publicly verifiable output is unknown during registration and resists precomputation by Sybil swarms. Participants commit to a nonce before the pulse; the revealed value combines with that commitment to derive the task, making cached offline work ineffective. Even a nebula voyage through a garden of task variants gains no advantage without timely, verifiable participation.
